to.evidence: REFUNDS 00: BRD v1.0 approved by the Head of Retail; REFUNDS 09 asks who follows the Business Objectives across all 40 branches. Neither BRD names a business sponsor.
REFUNDS 01: refunds are handled on paper and approved by phone today; LOYALTY 01: the current state is an open question. Neither BRD states the change type.
REFUNDS 01: customers wait up to 10 days today; 18% of complaints to customer care are about slow or lost refunds.
to.value: Refunds: replace paper records and phone approvals; cut the average time from refund request to payout from 10 days to 3 days; no refund request is lost and every request is visible to the customer; branch managers decide on their own branch's refunds in one place (REFUNDS 01 Business Objectives 1 to 3). The complaint and portal-share targets of objectives 4 and 5 are open in the BRD. Loyalty: members trust their points balance, measured as zero upheld balance complaints a month (LOYALTY 01 Objective 1, LOYALTY/NFR-01), and check their points without calling a branch (LOYALTY 01 Objective 2, targets open in the BRD).

to.label: Customer refund journey (REFUNDS UC-01 to UC-03)
to.value: The customer proves who they are, enters a branch receipt number, picks the items and a reason, submits the refund request, follows it until the money is back on the card, and cancels it while it is Submitted. Failure impact: a lost request or a customer without status, the cause of 18% of complaints to customer care (REFUNDS 01).

The branch manager decides on each Submitted request of their branch, oldest first: approve in full or in part, or reject with a reason; an approved refund is paid to the customer's original card through the payment provider and the request becomes Paid. Failure impact: refund money lost or paid twice (REFUNDS/NFR-01).

The member signs in, sees the points balance with the date of the last movement, and opens the history of points movements and the purchase or refund behind each. Failure impact: members call branches about points and lose trust in the balance (LOYALTY 01).

A member earns 1 point per 1 EUR spent on a branch purchase, from the purchases received from POS Records; points are taken back when the Refunds Portal reports a refund as paid. The member takes no action.

In scope: online refund requests for branch purchases; customers follow and cancel their own requests; branch manager decisions in full or in part; payout to the original card; customer messages by email and SMS; refund outcomes sent to Loyalty Points; a daily refund report per branch manager (REFUNDS 04). Earning points on branch purchases; points balance and history for members; taking points back when a refund is paid (LOYALTY 04). Out of scope: online-shop refunds, cash refunds, a customer mobile app (REFUNDS 04); redeeming points, handling points complaints and correcting points by hand (LOYALTY 04). The Refunds Portal starts in a pilot group of branches; each part goes live on its own date (REFUNDS 04, LOYALTY 04).

to.evidence: Neither BRD states a revenue, loss or safety impact per outage or per degraded minute.

to.value: A message that does not reach the customer never stops or changes a refund request; the customer can always see the current status (REFUNDS 03). When Point-of-Sale Records cannot be reached, customers are asked to try again later (REFUNDS UC-01 E5). A payout result may be recorded by hand by a staff member and confirmed by a second staff member (REFUNDS 03 Decision record). When points cannot be shown, the member is asked to try again later and no balance is shown (LOYALTY UC-01 E1). The maximum tolerable interruption is not stated beyond REFUNDS/NFR-02.

Planned maintenance counts toward the limit of 2 hours of disruption a month (REFUNDS/NFR-02) and toward the points-screen limit, whose minutes are open (LOYALTY/NFR-04). No maintenance window is stated.

Refund money is never lost or paid twice: zero missing or duplicate payouts per month, where a payout still being tried again or waiting for a card dispute at month end counts as delayed or waiting, not missing (REFUNDS/NFR-01). The decision record of every status change cannot be changed (REFUNDS 03). Every points movement follows the points rules, with zero upheld balance complaints a month (LOYALTY/NFR-01); each paid refund takes points back once, and the points taken back for a purchase never exceed the points it earned (LOYALTY UC-02 BR-3, BR-6).
